Problem Statement:
XYZ Bank needs to calculate the simple interest for a loan based on the principal amount, rate of interest, and time period. The formula for calculating simple interest is: Simple Interest=𝑃×𝑅×𝑇/100 Where: P is the principal amount, R is the rate of interest per year, T is the time period in years. Write a program to calculate the simple interest based on the above formula.
